Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call / next steps

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap from my side:

- Goal: understand traffic profile and latency SLOs so we can size Redwood Dedicated capacity and recommend model quantization / batching strategy.
- Current ask: proof of concept capacity planning and a technical deep dive with our SE to validate throughput and latency targets.
- Key internal attendees: Dylan (SE) + me; we expect a 45-60 minute focused session.

To keep momentum, could we schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call next week? Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 2026-02-18 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-02-18 14:00-15:00
- Thu 2026-02-19 09:00-10:00

Please confirm which slot works best and who from your side should attend (network/security/procurement if needed). Also, if you can fill out the attached capacity_template.xlsx with an estimate of:
- avg & peak requests per second
- avg tokens in / tokens out per request
- expected concurrency / number of concurrent users or sessions
- target p50/p95 latency SLOs

That will let Dylan come prepared with an initial sizing and a recommended Dedicated configuration. I attached a short capacity template to make this easier.

Next steps after the call: we'll share a written sizing recommendation and a rough pricing envelope for Dedicated.

Thanks, looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap. Wed 02/18 10:00-11:00 PT works for our team. I'll be on the call along with our infra lead (Alex Morales) and I've looped in procurement for scheduling/contract questions.

High-level traffic numbers to help you prep (these are current estimates):
- Average sustained requests: ~8-12 req/s
- Peak sustained requests: ~20 req/s (5-7 minute bursts during morning triage)
- Average tokens per response: ~350 tokens
- Typical input tokens: ~40 tokens
- Expected peak concurrency: ~45-60 concurrent users (chat sessions)
- Target latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for common prompts; p50 < 150ms

We're evaluating whether Redwood Dedicated is the right fit (vs. hosted with reservation), but given the throughput and our compliance needs, Dedicated looks promising. We'll try to fill the capacity_template.xlsx before the call, if not, I'll bring the numbers above.

Thanks, see you Wed.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of Digital Experience
Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com
